meta.name: recording
meta.description: Demo/recording mode that redacts personally identifiable and sensitive information from Claude Code's outputs. Use when the user invokes /recording or says they are about to record, screen-share, or demo their Claude Code session and want PII scrubbed in real time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时擦除屏幕录制中的敏感信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在录制或共享终端时自动隐藏敏感数据
copy.tagline_en: Redact sensitive info from screen recordings in real time
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to auto-hide sensitive data when recording or sharing your terminal

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在输出中自动把姓名、邮箱、日期、金额等敏感信息替换成明显假的占位数据，比如把真实姓名换成“Alex Doe”，把真实日期换成“2025-01-01”。代码逻辑和公开技术内容保持不变。
howto.when: 当你输入“/recording”或说“我要录屏”、“开始演示”时触发。再次输入“/recording”或说“停止录制”则关闭。

say.text: 我要开始录屏了，帮我隐藏敏感信息。

howto.what_en: When recording mode is active, Claude automatically replaces sensitive information (names, emails, dates, financial values, etc.) in its outputs with obviously fake placeholders like 'Alex Doe' or '2025-01-01'. Code logic and public technical content remain unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type '/recording' or say 'I'm about to record' / 'starting a demo'. Toggle off with '/recording' again or 'stop recording'.

say_en.text: I'm about to record my screen, please redact sensitive info.
